title: Prime Factorization Visualizer
description: Break any integer into primes with a factor-tree walk: each split of p × rest shown until all primes.
howto: Enter an integer of 2 or more.
Follow each tree split down to the prime factors.

faqs.a: Trial division from 2 upward — the first divisor found is always prime, so the tree splits n = p × (n/p).

faqs.q: What do the superscript numbers mean?
How large a number can it handle?
faqs.a: Up to 10¹². Primes near the cap are instant since trial division only runs to √n.
